gaps.sentence: Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.

gaps.sentence: He decided to go ___ for the chess championship.
gaps.explanation: 'Go in for' = take part in a competition.

gaps.sentence: She ___ down an offer from a rival university.
The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.

gaps.sentence: He puts his success down ___ hard work and a bit of luck.
gaps.explanation: put something down TO something = believe it has that cause.

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
They're ___ up a new office in the old warehouse district.
The subject cropped ___ again at dinner.
gaps.explanation: crop up = appear or happen unexpectedly.
